content.json:
# Storage Account Logs

Storage account diagnostics covering read/write/delete operations, authentication failures, latency trends, and capacity utilization.

content.query:
// Storage operations by type and status over time
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    SuccessCount = countif(StatusCode >= 200 and StatusCode < 300),
    ClientErrors = countif(StatusCode >= 400 and StatusCode < 500),
    ServerErrors = countif(StatusCode >= 500)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), OperationName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Blob Operations Over Time (Success / Client Error / Server Error)
Top 20 Blob Operations by Request Count

content.query:
// Authentication failures across all storage services
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where StatusCode == 403 or StatusCode == 401
| summarize FailureCount = count() by CallerIpAddress, AuthenticationType, OperationName, AccountName
| top 25 by FailureCount desc
| project AccountName, Operation = OperationName, CallerIP = CallerIpAddress, AuthType = AuthenticationType, FailureCount
content.title: Authentication Failures (401/403)
Anonymous Access Attempts

content.query:
// End-to-end latency trend (P50, P95, P99)
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where StatusCode >= 200 and StatusCode < 300
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Blob Latency Percentiles Over Time (P50 / P95 / P99)
Throttled Requests (429 / 503) Over Time

content.query:
// Data ingress/egress per account per hour
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    IngressMB = round(sum(RequestBodySize) / 1048576.0, 2),
    EgressMB  = round(sum(ResponseBodySize) / 1048576.0, 2)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), AccountName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Data Ingress / Egress per Account (MB)
